_source: Godot: LastRoute Godot/KyttusLabApp/game/config/player_models.gd (one body for every runner); rig and bone names from assets/hunters_blocky/player_mannequin/player_mannequin.bbmodel; standard swing amplitudes from src/bin/last_route/render/bbmodel.rs build_scaled (arm 0.9, leg 0.75).

bots._source: Rust-only: NPC teammates (game/npc.rs) wear the runner mannequin with the same bends; the skin is picked from `skins` by a hash of the guest name, so bots look like fake players. Standard walk amp 0.6 is the swing scene.rs used for NPCs before.
